title: Seed Operations Manager
purpose: Manage seed inventory for DL-012 clone groups. Track seed readiness, certification, and promotion. Automates the seed selection and management process.

seedIdentification.dl012: Template family groups where stem similarity > 90% — one item per group is the seed
seedIdentification.dl013: Boilerplate groups where one item has been remediated — that item is the seed
seedIdentification.deNovo: New items not part of any template family

seedReadiness.criteria: Same as certification candidate readiness: structural + identity + governance gates
seedReadiness.blockers: DL-008, DL-025, DL-026, DL-021, DL-034 block seed certification

seedCertification.process: Certify seed → promote clone siblings to Archival → mark group complete
seedCertification.verification: Independently verify seed correctness before certifying
